vague.zh: 母球沿台面被推向目标球并正面撞上。母球接触瞬间停死,目标球向前滚一段后被摩擦停住。
vague.en: The cue ball is pushed along the felt at the target ball and hits it head-on. The cue ball stops dead on contact and the target ball rolls forward before friction brings it to rest.

quantitative.zh: 母球以 1.0 m/s 被推出,滚过 0.57 m 后在第 15 帧正撞上目标球。母球接触瞬间停死,目标球向前滚 0.12 m 后被摩擦停住。
quantitative.en: The cue ball is pushed at 1.0 m/s and hits the target ball head-on on frame 15 after 0.57 m of travel. The cue ball stops dead on contact and the target ball rolls forward 0.12 m before friction brings it to rest.
